content.comment_body: I have placed over 200 function blocks on my PC monitor, and now it’s difficult to add more to the screen in [product_name]. Is there a way to increase the available workspace? I currently use a FullHD monitor. Would a 4K monitor help provide more space?
Could you clarify what you mean by workspace? Are you asking about adding extra pages to the diagram? If so, please refer to the attachment.
Understood, thank you very much! This solution makes me very happy.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced limitations in [product_name] when managing over 200 function blocks, as workspace constraints made expanding the diagram challenging. This suggests that users with complex projects may run into workflow issues due to the software’s display area. Another user’s advice to utilize additional pages in the diagram successfully addressed the concern, resulting in a positive outcome.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the software’s workspace can be expanded to handle a large volume of function blocks, simplifying work on complex diagrams.
